item.title: Gluon Quiz '26
item.author: diptanuj.ds@gmail.com (Diptanuj Sarkar)
item.dc:creator: Diptanuj Sarkar
item.description: Quiz by me and Sabarno for Gluon and IKQC
item.content:encoded:
After a long while, a resurgence of Gluon (The Journal Club of DPS) activity has given me and Sabarno reason to create a set. The Quiz is oriented around Physics - but it is no drag! (Unlike a certain other Academic Quiz that IKQC has to host sometimes).

A pool of questions selected from all the conversations we had in the Hostels fan-boying over the great physicists of the past and present.
